item: No cameras / no live view; responders get no visual verification
basis: CHEKT: no devices on record for site 35801; consequence follows directly
failure_risk: Owner has non-CHEKT cameras (doorbell etc.) not visible to responders
full_text: There are no cameras and no live view at this address. Responders get no visual verification before arrival.

item: Corner lot, two street frontages (Celilo W, collector N); both public approaches
basis: Clear top-down + 4 tilts; house sits between Celilo and the collector
failure_risk: N side may be a rear lot line with wall/no vehicle access (still a foot approach)
full_text: Corner lot with two street frontages (NW Celilo Ln on the W, the collector on the N). Both are public approaches.

item: E/NE opens onto undeveloped land, no fence/gate identifiable; approach unobserved
basis: Imagery 6/22/2024 shows native tract; fences are hard to resolve overhead
failure_risk: Subdivision was building out in 2024: tract may be developed by now; low fence present
full_text: The E/NE side opens onto undeveloped native land with no fence or gate identifiable. Approach from there is unobserved.

item: S side yard by 3261 is the blind side; front entry probably W by pad
basis: Narrow side yard is clear in imagery; entry location is a guess from pad/walk layout
failure_risk: Front door could face Celilo further S or be on the N frontage
full_text: The south side yard along the fence/wall with 3261 is the blind side. The front entry is probably on the W by the pad (verify).

item: REC: Knox box / lockbox for keys
basis: Rule of thumb; lockboxes are never visible from overhead
failure_risk: One already exists, or Bend Fire does not run a Knox program for homes
full_text: REC: Add a Knox box / lockbox for keys so responders are not forcing entry.

item: REC: House numbers readable from BOTH streets, lit
basis: Two frontages are clear; generic best practice
failure_risk: Numbers may already be posted on the collector side
full_text: REC: Put house numbers where they read from BOTH streets (Celilo and the collector), lit at night.

item: Arrive via collector (likely NW Skyline Ranch Rd), turn at T, drive 22 m on left; T = meet point
basis: Ruler 22.3 m; T geometry clear. The collector name is unverified and the arrival direction depends on dispatch routing
failure_risk: Wrong road name in a dispatch note; units arrive from the S on Celilo
confirm_by: Road-name check (county GIS / Google Maps); Bend Fire routing
full_text: Arrive on the collector (likely NW Skyline Ranch Rd, verify) and turn onto NW Celilo Ln at the T; the drive is 22 m (73 ft) from the T on the left. The T is the meet / ground-guide point, not a rated LZ.

item: Pad 17.2 × 6.2 m: an ambulance fits, no turnaround; patient path entry/garage → pad
basis: Ruler 17.2 m and 6.2 m vs a typical ambulance (~7–7.5 m × 2.6 m with mirrors): fits with room
failure_risk: Cars parked on the pad (2 in the imagery); slope; the 17.2 m includes apron/sidewalk
full_text: Driveway pad: 17.2 m (56 ft) street edge to garage face, 6.2 m (20 ft) wide at the mouth. An ambulance fits; there is no turnaround. Patient path: front entry / garage to the pad.

item: Celilo 11.5 m with parking both sides → don't stage; stage in collector curb/bike lane E of T
basis: Ruler 11.5 m − 2 × ~2.2 m parked ≈ 7 m clear (sound). Collector bike lane ~1.5–2 m is narrower than an engine (~2.6 m)
failure_risk: Staging in the bike lane intrudes on a travel lane; the agency may prefer Celilo or the T
full_text: Celilo is 11.5 m (38 ft) curb to curb with cars parked on both sides, so do not stage there. Stage in the collector curb / bike lane E of the T along the N frontage.

item: Three ways out (collector NW/SE, Celilo S/SW); rear reachable on foot via N strip + lawn
basis: Road network seen in 2024 context imagery; foot route clear overhead
failure_risk: New streets or closures since 2024; fence/gate blocks the N strip
full_text: Three ways out: the collector NW, the collector SE, and Celilo S/SW. The rear (E) side is reachable on foot across the N strip and lawn; gate status unknown.

item: REC: Back ambulance onto pad nose-out, or reverse out with spotter
basis: Pad geometry (ruler) supports it; tactics are the crew's call
failure_risk: Crew SOP differs; pad occupied
full_text: REC: Back the ambulance onto the pad (nose out toward Celilo), or nose in and reverse out with a spotter. Engines and ladders work from the street or the collector.

item: REC: Keep T clear; agree any LZ with agency; evacuate W away from E/SE fuel
basis: Fuel is clearly E/SE in imagery; LZ deferred to the agency
failure_risk: Wind or fire location makes W the wrong way
full_text: REC: Keep the T clear for ground-guiding and agree any LZ with the agency. If fire is in the E/SE tract, evacuate W via Celilo or along the collector, away from the fuel.

item: REC: Knox box, confirm side gate, numbers from both streets
basis: Mostly verification asks; low risk
failure_risk: Items already in place
full_text: REC: Add a Knox box / lockbox (none visible in imagery; verify), confirm whether a side gate exists to the rear yard, and post house numbers visible from both streets.

item: REC: With no cameras dispatch has no visual; verify collector name + entry
basis: CHEKT no-device record plus verification ask
full_text: REC: With no cameras, dispatch has no visual on arrival (see S). Verify the collector name and the front-entry location on a site visit.

item: E/SE undeveloped juniper/pine/sage tract is the WUI edge and heaviest fuel
basis: Clear in top-down and E tilt (6/22/2024)
failure_risk: Tract cleared/developed since 2024
full_text: Directly E/SE is an undeveloped tract of native juniper, pine and sagebrush, the WUI edge and the heaviest fuel load.

item: Irrigated lawn buffers E/SE; junipers 5–10 m E of lawn; no trees touch roof
basis: Green lawn is clear; 5–10 m is eyeballed from the scale bar, not a ruler line; 'irrigated' is inferred from June green
failure_risk: Distance off by 3+ m; lawn browned since
full_text: An irrigated lawn buffers the E/SE side. Junipers stand 5-10 m east of the lawn; no trees touch or overhang the roof.

item: Side walls 3–6 m from 3261 (S); construction lots W/SW
basis: Scale-bar estimate between roofs; framing visible in tilts
failure_risk: Eaves vs walls confuse the spacing; construction finished
full_text: Side walls are 3-6 m from the neighbour at 3261 (S): ember and radiant exposure in both directions. Construction lots lie W/SW.

item: REC: Lay in from WFH005944; first engine in collector curb lane beside it
basis: City GIS hydrant 19.4 m @349°, 6 in; the GIS point is approximate
failure_risk: Hydrant actually on the Celilo side or out of service; agency SOP
full_text: REC: Lay in from WFH005944: position the first engine in the collector curb lane beside it (dashed box), clear of the T.

item: REC: Keep lawn irrigated; lean, clean 0–30 ft zone E/SE; limb/thin nearest junipers
basis: Standard home-ignition-zone guidance; fuel location clear
failure_risk: Some of it already done
confirm_by: Deschutes County FireFree / Bend Fire assessment
full_text: REC: Keep the lawn irrigated and extend a lean, clean 0-30 ft zone on the E/SE; limb up and thin the junipers nearest the lawn.

item: REC: Ember-resistant vents; no bark mulch on N/W gravel strips
basis: Gravel strips visible; vent type and mulch unknowable overhead (generic)
failure_risk: Already compliant
full_text: REC: Use ember-resistant vents and keep the N/W gravel strips free of bark mulch against the walls (verify materials on site).

item: REC: Confirm hydrant positions and flow on site
basis: Verification ask; GIS points approximate
full_text: REC: Confirm hydrant positions and flow on site; GIS points are approximate.

item: Roof dark grey, uniform; no patching/moss/debris at resolution; no trees overhang
basis: Clear top-down at ~0.10 m/px
failure_risk: Defects smaller than resolution; 2024 imagery is stale
full_text: Roof: dark grey, colour uniform across all wings; no patching, staining, moss or debris visible at this resolution. No trees touch or overhang it.

item: Collector/Celilo show no cracking; pad condition can't be judged
basis: New-subdivision roads look clean; fine cracks are below resolution
failure_risk: Hairline cracking or post-construction damage
full_text: Surfaces: the collector and NW Celilo Ln show no visible cracking or patching. The pad is dark and partly shaded, so its condition cannot be judged.

item: REC: Roof: nothing to flag; owner decides on a closer look
basis: Same basis as the roof observation; resolution-limited
failure_risk: Shingle-level wear missed
full_text: REC: Roof: nothing observed to flag. Shingle-level wear is below this resolution; the owner can decide whether a closer look (e.g. a roofer) is wanted.

item: REC: Verify raised round roof element, 2 dark rectangles at curb, pale/dark lawn patches
basis: Features are visible in the imagery; this is a verification list
full_text: REC: Verify on site: the raised round roof element, the 2 dark rectangles at the Celilo curb, and the pale / darker patches by the N bed and lawn tip.

item: REC: Pad surface + irrigation not judgeable; check if owner cares
basis: Honest limit statement
full_text: REC: Pad surface and irrigation coverage could not be judged from imagery; check on site if they matter to the owner.

item: REC: Construction W/SW active at image date; check if finished
basis: Framed houses and dirt lots visible in tilts
full_text: REC: Construction W/SW was active at image date (dust, debris, traffic); check whether it is finished. The E/SE tract is uneven ground and fuel: see F.

item: One approach (~88 m drive); drive entry uncovered; first camera view is motor court
basis: Ruler 87.6 m (88.6 m in the DJI notes); surveyed pins/headings cluster at the court; entry is ~60 m+ beyond a 25 m view
failure_risk: Foot/ATV approach across open land; a court camera sees part of the drive
full_text: One approach: the ~88 m private drive from MacAlpine Loop. The drive entry is not covered; the first camera view is the motor court.

item: Open W/N perimeter (no fence), dirt track round court; dense conifers S/E limit sightlines
basis: GE 2024 and the DJI model (7/21/2026) both show open sage W/N and the track
failure_risk: A low wire/ranch fence not resolvable
full_text: Open perimeter on the W and N (no fence identified) with a dirt track around the sport court; dense conifers on the S and E limit sightlines.

item: Existing coverage concentrates on court frontage and rear decks/lawn
basis: 14 survey pins with headings (true), but FOV/range are default assumptions; only 4 linked to feeds
failure_risk: Actual views differ from the default wedges
full_text: Coverage concentrates on the court frontage and the rear decks / lawn.

item: Meet at drive entry; engines stage on loop; no LZ on parcel (dense canopy)
basis: Drive 3.7–3.8 m wide (ruler) supports staging on the loop. 'Dense canopy' is overstated: W/N is open sage with scattered trees in both GE and DJI
failure_risk: Agency would use open ground W/N or the loop as an LZ
full_text: Meet / ground-guide at the drive entry on MacAlpine Loop. Engines and ladders stage on the loop; no LZ on the parcel (dense canopy).

item: Paved motor court ~20–25 m; ambulance multi-point turn; patient path front entry (probable) → court
basis: Court not ruler-measured (GE notes #4); my scale-bar read puts paved area ~25–30 m. Entry supported by the FRONT DOOR camera and the 'Front walkway' pin on the court side
failure_risk: Parked cars cut turning room; entry elsewhere
confirm_by: Earth ruler line on court; site visit
full_text: The paved motor court (~20-25 m) takes an ambulance with a multi-point turn; patient path is front entry (probable) to the court.

item: Rear on foot via W side to N lawn 50.4 m; no S/E walk-around; drive only way out
basis: Ruler 50.4 m (51.8 m DJI notes). S/E judged blocked by trees; the ~2.5 m step is from an elevation profile only
failure_risk: E side passable via lawn/pool deck; step is a 3D artifact
full_text: Rear yard on foot via the W side of the house to the N lawn, 50.4 m (165 ft). There is no walk-around on the S/E. The drive is the only way out.

item: REC: Back up drive or turn in court; keep drive clear (single exit)
basis: Single paved drive confirmed in GE and DJI
failure_risk: Crew SOP
full_text: REC: Back the ambulance up the drive or turn it in the court before loading; keep the drive clear of parked apparatus so the single exit stays open.

item: REC: Ground-guide large apparatus from drive entry; agree LZ in advance
basis: Narrow 3.7–3.8 m drive (ruler) is below the 20 ft fire-access norm
full_text: REC: Ground-guide large apparatus from the drive entry; agree an LZ with the agency in advance.

item: REC: Confirm entry, any gate at drive entry, ~2.5 m step on W walk
basis: Verification ask
full_text: REC: Confirm the front-entry location, any gate at the drive entry, and the ~2.5 m step on the W walk route on a site visit.

item: REC: Knox box if none; address number at drive entry
basis: Rule of thumb; neither is visible from overhead
failure_risk: Already in place
full_text: REC: Add a Knox box / lockbox if none exists (none identifiable in imagery) and post the address number at the drive entry.

item: Irrigated N + E lawns are the only cleared buffer; S/SE has none
basis: Lawns N/E clear in GE + DJI. The DJI model also shows lawn by the motor court/S side and the pool deck E (both non-fuel)
failure_risk: Overstates the S/SE gap
full_text: The irrigated N and E lawns are the only cleared buffer. The S/SE has no equivalent cleared zone.

item: No City hydrant within 800 m AND no pool/pond/tank visible → tender or drafting
basis: Hydrant half: City GIS (only the City layer; other water providers' hydrants are not in it). Pool half is WRONG: the DJI model (7/21/2026) shows a lap pool E/NE by the pergola
failure_risk: Pool exists (possible draft source); a non-City hydrant may exist
confirm_by: Fire district (water supply); owner (pool volume, access)
full_text: No City of Bend hydrant within 800 m and no pool, pond or tank visible: water must come by tender or drafting.

item: Single drive through dense vegetation; no second egress
basis: Single drive clear; vegetation is dense near the house, sparser sage/juniper toward the loop
failure_risk: 'Dense' overstated for the outer half
full_text: The single drive winds through dense vegetation with no second egress (see A).

item: REC: Plan water supply (tender/drafting); confirm with fire district
basis: No City hydrant; pool now a candidate draft source
failure_risk: District already has a plan
full_text: REC: Plan water supply before arrival (tender shuttle / drafting) and confirm the source with the fire district.

item: REC: Owner: 30 ft lean/clean Zone 1 S/SE first, then Zone 2 crown spacing
basis: Standard home-ignition-zone guidance; trees against S/SE walls visible
failure_risk: Already done since 2024
full_text: REC: Owner: a 30 ft lean, clean Zone 1 on the S and SE first (thin shrubs, limb up), then open crown spacing in Zone 2.

item: REC: Check chimney spark arrestors + ember-resistant vents
basis: Verification ask; not determinable overhead
full_text: REC: Owner: check chimney spark arrestors and ember-resistant vents (not determinable from imagery).

item: REC: Keep drive limbed up; confirm width/height on site
basis: Ruler width 3.7–3.84 m; trees close in imagery
full_text: REC: Keep the drive corridor limbed up for apparatus clearance (confirm width and height on site).

item: Roof light tan, uniform; no patching/moss/debris/solar; one unclear dark patch E wing
basis: GE 2024 top-down. The DJI model (7/21/2026) shows a dark rectangular panel on the main roof (likely solar or skylight) and a greyer roof tone
failure_risk: 'No solar' is stale/wrong for the current roof
full_text: Roof: light tan, colour uniform across all wings; no patching, staining, moss, debris or solar visible at this resolution. One dark patch on the E wing is unclear.

item: Drive/court uniform; cracking not judgeable; sport court surface uniform
basis: GE resolution; the DJI model shows pale mottling on the court surface
failure_risk: Court wear or staining missed
full_text: Surfaces: the drive and motor court look uniform; drive cracking or patching cannot be judged at this resolution. The sport court surface looks uniform.

item: REC: Roof: nothing to flag; owner decides on the dark E-wing patch
basis: Same basis as the roof observation, which the newer DJI model contradicts
failure_risk: Solar/skylight or other change missed
full_text: REC: Roof: nothing observed to flag. The owner can decide whether a closer look (e.g. a roofer) at the dark patch on the E wing is wanted.

item: REC: Verify pale items W, court edge band, W walk step
basis: Features visible; verification list
full_text: REC: Verify on site: the pale items W of the house (logs / lumber / debris?), the sport court edge band, and the step on the W walk route.

item: REC: NW roof overhang + drive surface not judgeable; check if owner cares
basis: Honest limit statement
full_text: REC: Tree overhang at the NW roof edge and drive surface condition could not be judged from imagery; check if they matter to the owner.

item: REC: Open native land and dense canopy are fuel
basis: Clear in GE and DJI
full_text: REC: Open native land and dense canopy are fuel (see F).
